classification_legend.EXACT_DUPLICATE: The abstract mathematical claim/form is already standard and materially matched.
classification_legend.PARTIAL_ANTECEDENT: Standard theory covers a substantial proper part but not the entire bundled claim without additional hypotheses.
classification_legend.ADJACENT_METHOD: Nearby standard machinery is relevant only after extra hypotheses/translation.
classification_legend.NO_MATERIAL_MATCH: No material exact match found in the audited source set; this is not a novelty conclusion.

claims.subject: Short exact-sequence language 1 -> K -> G~ -> S4 -> 1
claims.external_boundary: Ordinary group-extension language; kernel, quotient and equivalence of extensions are standard.
claims.scope_guard: This does not identify a P000 hidden kernel or authorize quotienting native Cell identity.

claims.subject: Split extension / semidirect product / complement / homomorphic section
claims.external_boundary: A split extension is exactly one admitting a homomorphic section; semidirect-product reconstruction is standard.
claims.scope_guard: Existence of a section does not supply a canonical section.

claims.subject: Lifted presentation relations land in K
claims.external_boundary: If a relator is trivial in the quotient, the same word in arbitrary chosen lifts lies in the kernel; factor sets record this failure of a set section to be a homomorphism.
claims.scope_guard: A nontrivial residue for one chosen lift does not by itself imply the extension is nonsplit.

claims.subject: Central/abelian extensions and H^2 classification
claims.external_boundary: For abelian kernel A with fixed G-module action, extension equivalence classes are classified by H^2(G;A); central extensions are the trivial-action special case.
claims.scope_guard: Do not write H^2(S4,K) as a universal classifier without abelianity and a fixed S4-module action.

claims.subject: Nonabelian kernel / Schreier-Eilenberg-Mac Lane extension theory
claims.external_boundary: For nonabelian K the quotient determines only an outer action; existence carries an H^3(G,Z(K)) obstruction, and when realizable the extension classes form an H^2(G,Z(K))-torsor relative to the outer action.
claims.scope_guard: This is not ordinary H^2(G,K), and the torsor has no preferred zero extension in general.

claims.subject: Change of lift/section; conjugacy and nonuniqueness of complements
claims.external_boundary: Changing a set section changes factor-set representatives by coboundary; complement existence/conjugacy has standard theorems under additional hypotheses. Exact finite examples already show multiple nonconjugate complements when those hypotheses fail.
claims.scope_guard: No general theorem upgrades splitting to a unique or canonical complement; Schur-Zassenhaus-type conjugacy needs hypotheses such as the Hall/coprime setting.

claims.subject: Faithful permutation representations of S4, especially degree 4 and the induced action on six 2-subsets
claims.external_boundary: S4 is by definition the symmetric group on four letters; its natural four-point action and induced action on unordered pairs are classical permutation constructions.
claims.scope_guard: Gen12 novelty cannot reside in the abstract S4 representation; only its typed P000 realization can remain project-specific.

claims.subject: A faithful 24-element permutation image requires at least four points
claims.external_boundary: Faithfulness embeds the group into S_n. For n<4, |S_n|<=6<24, while S4 acts faithfully on four points.
claims.scope_guard: This is cardinality-minimality of a representation, not an ontology claim that P000 has four Cells.

claims.subject: Projective / covering-group analogies
claims.external_boundary: Schur's projective-representation theory and double covers of S4 are classical nearby machinery; M(S4) is C2 and classical covering groups exist.
claims.scope_guard: These sources apply to projective/central-extension hypotheses and do not prove that a P000 residue realizes a Schur cover, binary octahedral group or GL(2,3).

claims.subject: Automorphism/definability obstruction to a canonical section
claims.external_boundary: A definable object over fixed parameters must be fixed by automorphisms fixing those parameters. Hence an automorphism orbit moving candidate sections obstructs definable/canonical choice.
claims.scope_guard: Use only the necessary invariance direction unless stronger model-theoretic hypotheses are declared.

claims.subject: Universal existence versus existence in one model
claims.external_boundary: The existential statement 'some admitted model has a section' and the universal statement 'every admitted model has a section' are different first-order/model-class strengths.
claims.scope_guard: Gen12 is Driver-accepted only at existential common-model strength; no universal inference is licensed.

claims.subject: P000 compound semantics: opaque Cell, no carrier quotient, native-axis typing, downstream frame/PF10 decorations
claims.external_boundary: Audited sources separately cover group extensions, permutation actions, definability, torsors/connections and projective covers, but no source located duplicates the exact compound P000 operational package.
claims.scope_guard: NO_MATERIAL_MATCH != NOVELTY. This is a search boundary, not an originality, priority, patentability or Foundation claim.

required_guards.H2: Plain H^2(S4,K) classification requires K abelian plus a fixed S4-module action; central extensions are the trivial-action special case.
required_guards.NONABELIAN: For nonabelian K use outer-action/Schreier-Eilenberg-Mac Lane theory; H^3(S4,Z(K)) controls realizability and, after existence, H^2(S4,Z(K)) acts transitively on extension classes.
required_guards.GEN12: The four-point faithful S4 action and six-edge action are classical; Gen12 remains only an existential typed Full-Cell realization.
